item.title: Waymo recalls 3,800 robotaxis after they drive into flood waters
item.description:
📝 Incidents were captured on camera in Austin, Texas, and other locations, showing Waymo vehicles driving onto a flooded road, or stalling in traffic during heavy rain. Waymo said that it's put some fixes in place and is working on "additional software safeguards. Waymo autonomous vehicles in Austin, Texas were recently seen on camera driving onto a flooded street and stalling, requiring other drivers to navigate around them.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/12/waymo-recalls-3800-robotaxis-after-able-drive-into-standing-water.html
